visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up opening shot reveals a nine-grid bento box filled with various Thai-style side dishes and a central portion of white rice sprinkled with black sesame. The camera pans smoothly across the colorful compartments containing stir-fried pork, green beans, and tofu. (2) The scene shifts to a restaurant interior where two staff members in blue uniforms, masks, and caps are efficiently preparing bento boxes behind a glass counter. The background is a clean, commercial kitchen space. (3) A sequence of macro shots follows, showing wooden chopsticks picking up specific dishes: translucent noodles with vegetables, savory stir-fried pork with onions, and cubes of tofu in a reddish spicy sauce. The lighting is bright and emphasizes the texture of the sauces. (4) A spoon scoops minced meat and basil (pad kra pao) onto a bed of white rice, accompanied by a fried egg with crispy edges. (5) Close-up views of green curry with chicken and zucchini are shown, followed by chopsticks lifting long strands of stir-fried vermicelli. (6) A small plastic cup containing a soft, textured orange Thai steamed egg is held up, with chopsticks pulling a portion to show its consistency. (7) The final phase shows the exterior of 'Thai禾家' restaurant under a cloudy sky, followed by a shot of its modern, minimalist interior seating area with wooden stools and warm spotlighting.
